parsed.explanation: State-directed hostility is documented and enforced: the 2023 'extremism' designation produced 101 convictions, arrests for displaying rainbow symbols, and repeated police raids in which ~100 queer-venue patrons were searched and photographed; propaganda fines run to tens of millions of roubles, and a man detained over an LGBT travel agency died in pretrial custody. Recourse is absent — no anti-discrimination or hate-crime provision, no recording of anti-LGBT crime — and public disapproval is ~74%. Trans-specific law is hostile (2023 ban on transition and marker change; propaganda covering 'desire to change sex'), though application to foreign documents is unaddressed. Mitigating: no cross-dressing or facility ban, and no documented street stops of trans people or border friction for foreign passports, so exposure is expression- and venue-linked rather than universal. Above the 0.15 anchors (no on-sight targeting), below 0.35 (no universal-exposure rule).
